title: Drugs used in gynecology as a decision: which drug for heavy bleeding, painful periods, endometriosis, fibroids, ovulation induction, hirsutism, menopause and breast cancer; then each class on the estrogen, progestin and androgen axes, GnRH analogues and the non-hormonal drugs with when to choose, avoid and watch
root: Drugs used in gynecology · start from the problem

legend.label: raises venous thromboembolism (VTE) risk: deep vein thrombosis, pulmonary embolism
not a US Food and Drug Administration (FDA)-approved use

items.label: Past venous thromboembolism?
items.text: → tranexamic acid is contraindicated · estrogen, tamoxifen and raloxifene all ↑ clot risk

items.label: Uterus present?
items.text: → never estrogen alone: add a progestin (unopposed estrogen → endometrial cancer)

items.label: Severe renal failure, gastritis or ulcer, coagulation disorder?
Gonadotropin-releasing hormone agonist or antagonist?
items.text: → hypoestrogenic: add-back low-dose estrogen + progestin (relugolix + estradiol + norethindrone acetate)

groups.title: Non-hormonal
groups.desc: Treat menstrual symptoms, not the hormone cause.

lines.label: Avoid:
lines.text: severe renal failure · gastritis, peptic ulcer · coagulation disorder

groups.title: Progestin axis
groups.desc: Opposes estrogen on the endometrium; synergic with it on the breast.

drugs.name: Progestins
drugs.agents: levonorgestrel, norethindrone, desogestrel, drospirenone, medroxyprogesterone acetate (MPA)
drugs.moa: Secretory endometrium; side effects follow the off-target receptor

lines.label: Avoid:
lines.text: acne or hirsutism: androgenic ones (levonorgestrel) → drospirenone, cyproterone instead

lines.label: Watch:
lines.text: androgenic: weight, acne, hirsutism · mood, libido, bone · ↓ high-density lipoprotein (HDL), ↑ low-density lipoprotein (LDL)

drugs.name: Selective progesterone receptor modulators (SPRMs)
drugs.moa: Mixed agonist-antagonist at the progesterone receptor (mifepristone: antagonist)

lines.label: Choose when:
lines.text: ulipristal: emergency contraception, fibroids, endometriosis · mifepristone: termination, Cushing syndrome

list: emergency contraception or termination → the receptor modulators

groups.title: Gonadotropin-releasing hormone (GnRH) analogues
groups.desc: Upstream of all three axes: ↓ luteinizing hormone (LH) + follicle-stimulating hormone (FSH) → ↓ ovarian and testicular steroids.

drugs.name: GnRH agonists, continuous
drugs.moa: Flare first, then the pituitary desensitizes

lines.label: Choose when:
lines.text: abnormal uterine bleeding (Lupron: immediate, effective) · endometriosis · shrink fibroids · prostate cancer · infertility

lines.label: Watch:
lines.text: hypoestrogenic: bone loss, hot flashes, vaginal dryness, mood + sleep → add-back

drugs.name: GnRH antagonists
drugs.moa: Block the receptor: faster, NO flare

lines.label: Choose when:
lines.text: controlled ovarian stimulation for in vitro fertilization · relugolix + add-back for endometriosis, fibroids

ask.q: Fibroids, endometriosis not controlled, or in vitro fertilization (IVF)?

groups.title: Androgen axis
groups.desc: Testosterone → dihydrotestosterone (DHT) (5α-reductase): hair follicles, prostate, genitalia.

groups.title: Estrogen axis
groups.desc: Too much: estrogen-dependent growth, infertility. Too little: menopause symptoms, bone loss.

drugs.name: Estrogens
drugs.moa: Estrogen receptor (ER) agonist: grows endometrium + breast, keeps bone

lines.label: Choose when:
lines.text: contraception (with a progestin) · ovarian dysgenesis · osteoporosis · dysmenorrhea · male-to-female transition

lines.label: Avoid:
lines.text: alone with a uterus: unopposed → endometrial cancer

lines.label: Watch:
lines.text: ↑ factors VII–X → venous thromboembolism (VTE) · headache, nausea, breast tenderness, edema

drugs.name: Selective estrogen receptor modulators (SERMs)
drugs.moa: Agonist in some tissues, antagonist in others

lines.label: Choose when:
lines.text: tamoxifen: estrogen receptor-positive breast cancer · raloxifene: postmenopausal osteoporosis · clomiphene: ovulation induction

lines.label: Watch:
lines.text: tamoxifen ↑ endometrial cancer; raloxifene does not

drugs.name: Aromatase inhibitors · fulvestrant
drugs.moa: Block androgen → estrogen · pure estrogen receptor antagonist

lines.label: Choose when:
lines.text: aromatase inhibitor: breast or ovarian cancer, infertility · fulvestrant: advanced breast cancer
